[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Mehtani Keys | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=488 }} The [[Mehtani Keys]] is situated at the southeastern end of [[Istan]] and is dotted with cays, small islands, and sandy beaches. There is a small Istani fishing village in the northernmost island, but overall, this area is populated by many unfriendly [[skale]], hidden [[mandragor]]s, and hostile [[plant]]s. It is also frequented by [[corsair]]s engaged in shady dealings or as a good staging area from which to launch raids into Istani settlements. {{TOCright}} ==Getting there== Characters will likely come here for the first time as part of the [[primary quest]] [[Isle of the Dead (quest)|Isle of the Dead]], which can be acquired after completion of the [[Jokanur Diggings]] [[mission]]. and Dahlah]] can be seen at the southwestern and the southeastern corner respectively. They appear to be remnants of the first kingdom and resemble the structure shown in the [[Istan]] loading screen. * By the [[Treasure Chest]] on the southwestern island is a shipwreck and a block of jade. Based on [[Jatoro Musagi]]'s dialogue, that ship was most likely the ship Jatoro was on, carrying jade from [[Cantha]], before being waylaid by [[corsair]]s. * After killing [[Commander Werishakul]] and his group in the corsair-ridden area to the southeast, the nearby [[Istani Commoner]] and the two [[Young Child|young children]], presumably held prisoners, will run toward the ship at the dock and disappear. *In the northeast corner near [[Ajamduk, Hunter of the Sands|Ajamduk]], there are several low sandy islands where only shallow water is shown on the map. {{Explorable areas in Istan}} [[Category:Has Sunspear bounties]] [[de:Mehtani-Archipel]]
